records.text: R7 covers Cedar and Bay. GO requires both sites within the current latency limit, rollback tested at both, and recorded approval. Otherwise HOLD.
Correction: the latency limit is 120 ms, replacing 80 ms. This changes the limit, not earlier measurements.
Cedar latency was 100 ms over 20 read-only requests. They passed the current limit. No write-path result is reported.
No Bay latency measurement is available.
Two Cedar summary reports reuse the same acquisition as m03; they are not independent tests.
Rollback was tested at Cedar only. Bay rollback has not been tested.
Approval was requested. Its linked receipt is unavailable, so approval is unverified, not granted or denied.
A post-release monitor is proposed; it has not been started. The next handover is at 10:00.
